'''Sabu Thomas''' (born 14 March 1960) is an Indian professor who also served as the [[vice-chancellor]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://twitter.com/KeralaGovernor/status/1132985316359299076|title=As Chancellor, appointed Prof. (Dr.) Sabu Thomas, Professor, School of Chemical Sciences, MG University, as Vice Chancellor, MG University, Kottayam as per Section 10 of Mahatma Gandhi University Act 1985s, 2010 for four years from the date on which he assumes office.pic.twitter.com/0BQotmnyiw|first=Kerala|last=Governor|date=27 May 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.ndtv.com/education/prof-sabu-thomas-appointed-mahatma-gandhi-university-vice-chancellor-2043718 |title = Prof Sabu Thomas Appointed Mahatma Gandhi University Vice Chancellor}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.mathrubhumi.com/education-malayalam/news/prof-sabu-thomas-appointed-vc-of-mg-university-1.3827840 |title = പ്രൊഫ. സാബു തോമസിനെ എം.ജി.സര്‍വകലാശാല വൈസ് ചാന്‍സലറായി നിയമിച്ചു}}</ref> of [[Mahatma Gandhi University, Kerala]]. He is also a full professor (25 March 1998 onwards) of Polymer Science and Engineering at the School of Chemical Sciences. He was the [[Pro-Vice Chancellor]] of [[Mahatma Gandhi University, Kerala]] during the period of 31 August 2017 to 31 August 2018, Director of School of Chemical Science during the period of 1 November 2010 to 31 December 2013.  Hon. Director of [https://www.mgu.ac.in/academics/centres/international-inter-university-centre-for-nanoscience-and-nanotechnology/    International & Inter-University Centre for Nanoscience and Nanotechnology] during the period of 28 March 2009 to 11 September 2015, 2 February 2016 to 11 October 2017.

== Early life ==
Sabu Thomas was born on 14 March 1962. He completed his schooling at Kumaranalloor Devi Vilasom HSS. He studied pre-degree at CMS College, Kottayam and then obtained BSc Degree in Chemistry from Kuriakose Elias College, Mannanam, Kottayam in 1980 and Bachelor of Technology Degree in Polymer Science and Rubber Technology from [[Cochin University of Science and Technology]] in 1983. He received his PhD from [[Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur]] in 1987.

== Academic research ==
His areas of academic research include [[polymer nanocomposite]]s and cellulose nanocomposites. He is the editor of the [[Elsevier]] journal ''Nano-Structures & Nano-Objects''.<ref>{{Cite book | url=https://www.journals.elsevier.com/nano-structures-and-nano-objects/editorial-board | title=Nano-Structures & Nano-Objects Editorial Board}}</ref>

== Awards and recognition ==
In 2015, he received his first [[Docteur Honoris Causa]] from [[University of Southern Brittany]] in Lorient, France.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www-limatb.univ-ubs.fr/limatb-highlights-452760.kjsp?RH=LIMATB | title=Laboratoire LIMATB – LIMATB Highlights}}</ref> In 2016, he received his second Doctorate honoris causa from [[University of Lorraine]], France.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://factuel.univ-lorraine.fr/node/6958 | title=Portrait d'un Docteur Honoris Causa (2/2) : Sabu Thomas &#124; Factuel| date=13 September 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://ijl.univ-lorraine.fr/actualites/les-actualites-par-themes/details-categories/le-pr-sabu-thomas-nomme-docteur-honoris-causa-de-l-universite-de-lorraine/ | title=Institut Jean Lamour: Le Pr. Sabu Thomas nommé Docteur Honoris Causa de l'Université de Lorraine}}</ref> He was awarded the [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry]], London, FRSC in 2012. He received the Bronze Medal of the [[Chemical Research Society of India]]<ref name="CRSI Bronze Medal">{{Cite web |url=http://www.crsi.org.in/index.php/crsi-awards/year-2013 |title=Awards: Year – 2013 |date=2018 |publisher=Chemical Research Society of India}}</ref> and the MRSI Medal of the Material Research Society of India in 2013.<ref name="Awards and honors">{{Cite web |url=http://www.mrsi.org.in/awardshonours.php |title=Awards and honors |date=2018 |publisher=Material Research Society of India}}</ref> He was the recipient of [[Fulbright-Nehru International Education Administrators Award]] 2017.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.cies.org/grantee/sabu-thomas | title=Sabu Thomas &#124; Fulbright Scholar Program}}</ref> He received TRiLA Academician of the year 2018 award.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.tyretimes.com/dr-sabu-thomas-winner-for-trila-academician-of-the-year/ | title=DR. SABU THOMAS WINNER FOR TRILA ACADEMICIAN OF THE YEARTyretimes &#124; Tyretimes}}</ref>
